00073 #define BinaryOpSymbolUGenProcessBlock(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL)                            \
00074         const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                                                      \
00075         float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                                                              \
00076         const float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);           \
00077         const float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);         \
00078                                                                                                                         \
00079         for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i) {                                                                  \
00080             outputSamples[i] = leftOperandSamples[i] OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL rightOperandSamples[i];                          \
00081         }

00096 #define BinaryOpSymbolUGenProcessBlock_K(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL)                          \
00097         const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();                                                        \
00098         unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;                                                             \
00099         int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                                                            \
00100         float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                                                              \
00101         float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);                 \
00102         float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);               \
00103                                                                                                                         \
00104         int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;                                                                 \
00105                                                                                                                         \
00106             while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                                                                            \
00107                 float nextValue = value;                                                                                \
00108                 if(numKrSamples == 0)                                                                                   \
00109                     nextValue = *leftOperandSamples OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightOperandSamples;                             \
00110                                                                                                                         \
00111                 numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;                                                              \
00112                                                                                                                         \
00113                 blockPosition       += numKrSamples;                                                                    \
00114                 leftOperandSamples  += numKrSamples;                                                                    \
00115                 rightOperandSamples += numKrSamples;                                                                    \
00116                                                                                                                         \
00117                 if(nextValue == value) {                                                                                \
00118                     while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                                                        \
00119                         *outputSamples++ = nextValue;                                                                   \
00120                         --numSamplesToProcess;                                                                          \
00121                         --numKrSamples;                                                                                 \
00122                     }                                                                                                   \
00123                 } else {                                                                                                \
00124                     float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();                             \
00125                     while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {                                                        \
00126                         *outputSamples++ = value;                                                                       \
00127                         value += valueSlope;                                                                            \
00128                         --numSamplesToProcess;                                                                          \
00129                         --numKrSamples;                                                                                 \
00130                     }                                                                                                   \
00131                     value = nextValue;                                                                                  \
00132                 }                                                                                                       \
00133             }                                                                                                           \

00410     UGenArray UGenArray::operator OPSYMBOL (UGenArray const& rightOperand) const throw()                                \
00411     {                                                                                                                   \
00412         int size;                                                                                                       \
00413                                                                                                                         \
00414         if(internal->size_ > rightOperand.internal->size_)  size = internal->size_;                                     \
00415         else                                                size = rightOperand.internal->size_;                        \
00416                                                                                                                         \
00417         UGenArray newArray(size);                                                                                       \
00418                                                                                                                         \
00419         for(int i = 0; i < size; i++) {                                                                                 \
00420             newArray.internal->array[i] = wrapAt(i) OPSYMBOL rightOperand.wrapAt(i);                                    \
00421         }                                                                                                               \
00422                                                                                                                         \
00423         return newArray;                                                                                                \
00424     }                                                                                                                   \

00426     Buffer Buffer::operator OPSYMBOL (Buffer const& rightOperand) const throw()                                         \
00427     {                                                                                                                   \
00428         const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; \
00429         const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                                    \
00430         const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                                    \
00431         const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize;                                                                           \
00432                                                                                                                         \
00433         Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));                                                   \
00434                                                                                                                         \
00435         for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++)                                        \
00436         {                                                                                                               \
00437             int numSamples;                                                                                             \
00438             float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data;                                           \
00439             float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data;                \
00440             float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                                              \
00441                                                                                                                         \
00442             if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) {                                                                       \
00443                 numSamples = maxSize;                                                                                   \
00444                                                                                                                         \
00445                 while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                              \
00446                     *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;                                  \
00447                 }                                                                                                       \
00448             } else if(rightOperand.size_ == 1 && rightOperand.numChannels_ == 1) {                                      \
00449                 numSamples = maxSize;                                                                                   \
00450                                                                                                                         \
00451                 while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                              \
00452                     *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples;                                  \
00453                 }                                                                                                       \
00454             } else {                                                                                                    \
00455                 numSamples = minSize;                                                                                   \
00456                 while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                              \
00457                     *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;                                \
00458                 }                                                                                                       \
00459                                                                                                                         \
00460                 numSamples = diffSize;                                                                                  \
00461                 if(size_ > rightOperand.size_) {                                                                        \
00462                     while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                          \
00463                         *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL 0.f;                                        \
00464                     }                                                                                                   \
00465                 }                                                                                                       \
00466                 else if(rightOperand.size_ > size_) {                                                                   \
00467                     while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                          \
00468                         *outputSamples++ = 0.f OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;                                       \
00469                     }                                                                                                   \
00470                 }                                                                                                       \
00471             }                                                                                                           \
00472         }                                                                                                               \
00473                                                                                                                         \
00474         return newBuffer;                                                                                               \
00475     }                                                                                                                   \

00479         if(rightOperand.isNull())   return Buffer(leftOperand);                                                         \
00480         else                        return Buffer(leftOperand) OPSYMBOL rightOperand;                                   \

00579     {                                                                                                                   \
00580         const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; \
00581         const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                                    \
00582         const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                                    \
00583         const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize;                                                                           \
00584                                                                                                                         \
00585         Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));                                                   \
00586                                                                                                                         \
00587         for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++)                                        \
00588         {                                                                                                               \
00589             int numSamples;                                                                                             \
00590             float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data;                                           \
00591             float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data;                \
00592             float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                                              \
00593                                                                                                                         \
00594             if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) {                                                                       \
00595                 numSamples = maxSize;                                                                                   \
00596                                                                                                                         \

00598                     *outputSamples++ = ugen::OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*leftSamples, *rightSamples++);                        \
00599                 }                                                                                                       \

00601                 numSamples = maxSize;                                                                                   \
00602                                                                                                                         \
00603                 while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                              \
00604                     *outputSamples++ = ugen::OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*leftSamples++, *rightSamples);                        \
00605                 }                                                                                                       \

00608                 while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                              \
00609                     *outputSamples++ = ugen::OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*leftSamples++, *rightSamples++);                      \
00610                 }                                                                                                       \
00611                                                                                                                         \
00612                 numSamples = diffSize;                                                                                  \
00613                 if(size_ > rightOperand.size_) {                                                                        \
00614                     while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                          \
00615                         *outputSamples++ = ugen::OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*leftSamples++, 0.f);                              \
00616                     }                                                                                                   \
00617                 }                                                                                                       \
00618                 else if(rightOperand.size_ > size_) {                                                                   \
00619                     while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                                                          \
00620                         *outputSamples++ = ugen::OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(0.f, *rightSamples++);                             \
00621                     }                                                                                                   \
00622                 }                                                                                                       \
00623             }                                                                                                           \
00624         }                                                                                                               \
00625                                                                                                                         \
00626         return newBuffer;                                                                                               \
